## Featured product: DocKnock

DocKnock is a healthcare platform for secure communication between medical professionals and patients. Built by Team Arsenal (Iyed Grassi, Louay Sassi, Leith Saddouri) for MutualHack 3.0 by MAE (May 22–23, 2026, Tunis). Won 1st prize (10,000 TND) among ~2,000+ applicants / 24 finalist teams. Now in incubation with MAZAM.
